claims.statement: One successor primary execution exposes final hidden, final normalized, and full logits from the same execution.
One successor secondary execution exposes final hidden, final normalized, and full logits from the same execution.
Primary formulas and operation order are unchanged from V2.
Secondary formulas and operation order are unchanged from V2.
Primary successor legacy API is exactly V2-equivalent for every frozen input.
Secondary successor legacy API is exactly V2-equivalent for every frozen input.
Primary output buffers contain exact f64le bits bound to legacy hashes.
Secondary output buffers contain exact f32le bits bound to legacy hashes.
Successor cores add no I/O, checkpoint, lifecycle, authorization, subprocess, reflection, or callback capability.
Event 05 can obtain all three outputs per role from one execution.
Primary and secondary numerical implementations remain independent.
V11 wrappers bank all six payloads without recomputation or full-array control JSON.
V11 receipts and terminals close over exact successor payload bytes.
Complete numerical requalification accepts the successor interface.
Exact-head FULL_NATIVE accepts V11 with zero required native skips.
